gloss: to keep falling (rain, snow); to continue to fall

definitions.gloss: to keep falling; to continue to fall; to rain/snow continuously
definitions.explanation: Used for precipitation (rain, snow, etc.) that continues without stopping. A compound verb formed from 降る (to fall) + 続く (to continue).

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: It rained continuously for three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It has been snowing since morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かない→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, it rains for days on end, so the laundry won't dry.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (to fall — precipitation) + ⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue). Used exclusively for precipitation — rain, snow, hail, etc. — falling without interruption.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}く: rain continues to fall
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}く: snow continues to fall
- ⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}く: to keep falling for days

COMMON PATTERNS:
Conjugates as a godan verb (く row): {降|ふ}り{続|つづ}かない、{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いて、etc. The transitive counterpart ⟦{降|ふ}り→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to keep letting fall) is not normally used, as precipitation is not a volitional action.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{止|や}まない→降り止む：27987_furiyamu⟧: to not stop falling — emphasizes the lack of cessation
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧: to pour down — emphasizes intensity rather than duration
